You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. (also matched: suspected_outage) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Prescription module and medication alerts not loading

It appears the electronic prescribing module is completely down or failing across our workstation terminals, as none of our out-of-stock medication substitution alerts are loading.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hi,

Thank you for letting us know about the issue you’re experiencing with the electronic prescribing module and medication alerts. I’m sorry for the inconvenience this is causing.

I’ve escalated this to a member of our support team, and they are now looking into the problem. We’ll keep you updated as we learn more.

If you have any additional details that might help us investigate, please feel free to share them.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Your Support Team]"
}
